description: User clarification: the general check is to compare the built model/game with the source images, correct flipped or otherwise inconsistent features, and compare again. Apply across the scene, not just a handle or a coordinate bug. Make this the core repo-local skill and mandatory AGENTS instruction; publish it in agent-readable knowledge. Use existing video/photos first and do not blame motion or request reshooting without demonstrating an evidence gap. Keep the small existing-camera regression as a supporting check, not the main workflow. Validate, perform an actual rendered comparison, publish, verify and close.
